card.name: Just before a medical term in a list
card.fires_on: Small words, opening brackets and word starts that sit right before a medical term, such as 'of' before arrhythmia, '(' before a bracketed example, or 'calcium' before pyrophosphate. Also seen partway through a drug name like fexinidazole.

modes.label: Opening bracket or link before a term
modes.description: A parenthesis, 'e.g.,' or 'of' that comes just before a named condition, chemical or example.
modes.example: Some fluoroquinolones, including CIPRO, have been associated with prolongation of the QT interval on the electrocardiogram and cases<< of>> arrhythmia.

modes.label: Inside chemical or drug names
modes.description: A part of a chemical or drug name where the rest of the name is still to come.
modes.example: plasma concentrations of fexinidazole's active metabolites: fexinidazole sulfoxide (M1) and fexinid<<azole>> sulfone (M2).

card.plain: It marks the spot just before a specific medical or chemical name is about to appear.
